about: Test prompts for the before/after experiment only — not needed to use the skill. Each prompt is built once WITHOUT the skill (baseline) and once WITH it, by the same model, then both pages are audited and screenshotted.
output_rule: Output a single self-contained index.html (inline CSS/JS; Google Fonts allowed).
